lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular blobs arranged in irregular horizontal rows along the mid-lateral flank posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased intensity intersecting with circular blobs to form a loose grid pattern across the mid-body section.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct longitudinal ridges visible on the upper flank, characterized by a highlight-to-shadow gradient running parallel to the dorsal midline.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of low-count, high-luminance spots localized within the anterior and central regions of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch or irregularity is present on the posterior trailing edge of the second dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-intensity spot patterning present on the dorsal surface of the left pectoral fin and the upper lobe of the caudal fin.
